notes.title: Mar. 13, 2025 Update
notes.content:
This Shiftall Controller Driver (Mar. 13, 2025) includes an update to the Shiftall Controller Driver and FlipVR firmware (Rev. 7).
The fixes in this version are as follows.


 Eliminates joystick input disconnection problem


Please see 2024/11/28 update for instructions on how to update.

notes.title: Nov. 28, 2024 Update
notes.content:
This Shiftall Controller Driver(Nov. 28, 2024) includes an update to the Shiftall Controller Driver and FlipVR firmware (Rev.6).
This firmware (Rev.6) is an improved version based on the firmware Beta version (Rev.4,5) and includes the following changes
For FlipVR users shipped in November 2024, the firmware (Rev6) has been written and doesn't need to be updated.


 Increased joystick dead zone
 Increased trigger dead zone
 Increased grip dead zone
 Decreased overall sensitivity of touch sensors
 Changes to calibration UI for trigger, grip, and joystick


How to update FlipVR's firmware

[olist]
 You will be able to select device updates as shown in the image below when you launch SteamVR with the FW update available.

 Connect the controller to be updated to the PC via USB and select "Update device".
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064861/5d083daf35a631c4ec56e8dbfb5dfa0b72d4e81c.png

 Continue with Yes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064861/2c66822fa8d12895d367c4b842f549bb76cc4f12.png

 If USB is not connected, a warning will appear, so please connect USB.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064861/fe7427e8bc7982ef0780f4498ce9ff9f9418050e.png

 Please do not disconnect the USB while updating.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064861/9f912a0c34dbdbedd92c9c4601a548deb703a41a.png

 When you see “Success!”, the update is complete.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064861/4efac1102aac607f4b25748f2d3688843a3fff71.png

 You can also update from “Update More Devices".
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064861/fcef649c1338e015380b856ef7056b288c253a8c.png
[/olist]

How to update the position of the avatar's hands of FlipVR

In some applications such as VRChat, For those who feel that the position of the hands in the real world is out of alignment with the position of FlipVR, we provide an update to adjust the position of the visible position of the hands.
This update can be performed by following the steps below. Please note that this update is irreversible, so please do not update if you are not dissatisfied with the current hands position.

[olist]
 Connect only one FlipVR to the USB port of your PC via a wired USB connection.
Please use either “C to C” or “A to C”, but it must be a cable that allows data transmission.

 Open a command line with administrator permissions and do the following steps,
Press the Windows key → type “cmd” → right-click and run with administrative permissions

 Input the following text and press “ENTER” to open the folder.
cd C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Shiftall Controller Drivers\bin\win64
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064861/0cdda3feb2053b7bdb30d2926a757a9f1e65651f.png

 Input the following text and press “ENTER” to execute.
flipvr_device_json_repair.exe
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064861/ebfca442b137270688116aea8a4c4af17fc563b6.png

 Note: If you have changed the default folder of Steam installation, please search the folder and find “flipvr_device_json_repair.exe” and execute it after entering the folder by “cd command”.

 If the process is successful, you will see a “Select mode” prompt. Then, enter “0” (zero) and press “ENTER” to execute the update.
If the message “Successfully updated.” is displayed, the update has been completed.
If the other controller has not yet been configured, follow the same procedure to update it.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064861/09cda9150200318f75961928b782ee0fb03f2c21.png

 Please check VRChat or other apps for updated hand positions.
[/olist]


For those who do not reach maximum trigger grip

If the trigger, grip, and joystick values do not reach their maximum values or are out of alignment, they can be calibrated.
Please refer to the video below to learn how to calibrate.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f_JW34iKdkU
